tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas. Text on it: foreground, muted-foreground, accent-text.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on background, card and muted (18:1 light, 16:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surface: bento cards, inputs, tab thumbs. Text on it: foreground, muted-foreground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: tab tracks, the active row, the guide box. Put foreground on it (muted-foreground is 4.7:1 on it in light).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on background, card and muted (4.9:1 on background in light, 6.3:1 on card in dark). Never for the only copy of important information.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every divider and card edge, always 1px. Decorative: a control also needs a fill, a label or the focus ring.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ink fill of the one main button per view. Text on it: primary-foreground.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset. 18:1 on background in light, 16:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Deep teal, the only accent (oklch 0.50 0.09 190 in light). Used sparingly as a fill or mark: selection tint, the Cover disc. White text on it in light (5.7:1), ink in dark (10.6:1). Not a button colour, not a headline colour, not the logo.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet teal tint behind the selected option in a list. Put foreground on it, and a check mark so selection is not colour alone.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text on background and card: the active nav label (with a muted pill behind it and aria-current). 5.5:1 on background in light, 10.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: pastel-green
tokens.usage: Fill of the Open License tag only.

tokens.name: pastel-amber
tokens.usage: Fill of the Free License tag only.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error text. Always with words.

tokens.name: pair-palenight-bg
tokens.usage: Palenight Theme background. Content colour inside PairWindow and Pair chips only. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: pair-gruvbox-bg
tokens.usage: Gruvbox Dark Hard background. Content colour, same in both themes.

tokens.name: pair-aura-bg
tokens.usage: Aura Dark background. Content colour, same in both themes.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The hook, on exactly two lines, centred. One per page. Weight 400 only.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under the hook. 52 to 60 characters wide.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav links, field labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Settings and file names. Inside PairWindow the Pair's own Font replaces it.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between a lead paragraph and its buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, inputs, tags, the logo circle, Pair chips.

shadow.note: Almost none. Depth comes from a 1px border and, on hover, one diffuse shadow under 5% opacity.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Card hover and the Snapshot image.
